description: Painted sprite for the rebel knight (?art=paint): one whole image, eyes painted in. Step 1 paints a full-body game pose from the reference crop, the style sheet and the SVG rig's pose; step 2 removes the background. Then tools/art/sprite.mjs trims it, thickens the outer outline and writes src/assets/sprites/rebel-knight.webp.

steps.name: pose
steps.prompt: Full-body game sprite, painted as one single whole image, of the rebel KNIGHT from the first image, painted in the art style of the second image (a character select sheet). Use the third image only for the full-body pose, chunky proportions and where he holds the hobby horse, not for its style. SUBJECT: a scrappy rebel exile knight. On his head a tall rusty steel bucket helm with straight sides and a flat top, orange rust blotches and a crack, and a T-shaped opening at the front that shows bare skin and two small black dot eyes, no mouth, no nose. A blue neckerchief knotted at his throat with its point hanging over his chest, a brown leather vest with a dark belt, cream shirt sleeves with one green square patch on the back sleeve, short dark brown boots. He rides a wooden HOBBY HORSE: a big carved brown wooden horse head in profile facing right, with two pointed ears, a dark brown mane, a black dot eye and a simple dark leather bridle, on the end of a plain straight wooden stick. His right fist visibly grips the horse's neck just under the head, at waist height in front of his belly; the stick runs from that fist down and back between his legs to touch the ground behind his left heel, and the horse head rises on the right side of the figure, its ears about level with the bottom of his helm, clear of the helm. The horse head is compact and clearly a chess knight's horse head. Standing, three-quarter view facing right, feet visible, chunky and big-headed: the bucket helm is about half the figure's height. EYES: two small black dot eyes painted on the bare skin inside the T-shaped opening, side by side, level, clearly visible. POSE: a natural, anatomically correct pose. Each arm hangs from its own shoulder, the elbows bend the natural way and the hands sit at the ends of the arms; nothing is backwards, reversed or twisted. The weapon is gripped firmly in the front fist with the fingers wrapped round it, never floating. SILHOUETTE: one clean, readable silhouette with simple chunky shapes and few interior lines, nothing thin dangling off it. A VERY thick black outer outline runs all the way round the whole silhouette, about twice as thick as the inner lines, so the figure reads clearly at 48 pixels tall. STYLE to match the second image exactly: bold flash-era 2D brawler cartoon, very thick even black outlines, flat fills, one hard cel shadow, crisp white highlights on metal, earthy colours with the blue neckerchief as the one bright accent. One character only, centred, on a plain flat light grey background (#d8d8d8), no ground, no cast shadow, no text, no labels, no frame.
